workflow.name: design_studio
workflow.title: Design studio
workflow.description: Turn a product brief into a coherent experience architecture and implementation-ready design handoff.

phases.title: Design foundation
phases.purpose: Name a distinctive design language, emotional target, hierarchy, content voice, accessibility principles, and the stock/default treatment this product must avoid. Use the Native Pro standard: opinionated product character expressed through native interaction conventions, restrained depth, clear typography, and purposeful motion.

phases.title: Experience architecture
phases.purpose: Specify information architecture, primary and recovery flows, navigation, and every meaningful empty, loading, error, offline, permission, and completion state. Tie each flow to a user goal and remove decorative steps.

phases.title: Design handoff
phases.purpose: Produce an implementation-ready handoff: screen inventory, component and token vocabulary, responsive behavior, interaction states, content rules, accessibility behavior, and measurable acceptance checks. Resolve contradictions rather than leaving alternatives for builders to guess between.
